8.11. iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms.track¶

The module defines functions for track circuits.

Functions

buildTrackCircuitPath(path, railyard[, …]) Function returning the “shifted path” of a given path.
checkSingleTrackCircuitCondition(railyard[, …]) Check if every edge is contained in at most and/or at least one track circuit.
generateMissingTrackCircuits(railyard, …) Generate virtual track circuits covering all edges not contained in any track circuit.
